items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions John Lewis in the context of Ella Fitzgerald's band (Maldiez Quartet) and the interviewee (Wilbur B. Ware, Sr) is not explicitly stated to have interacted with him, only that the interviewer mentions the group.

ctx.x: Ella -- it was Johnny Griffin, and Babs, Wilbur Campbell Camel, George Freeman, and I forgot this kid's name -- I got it down on an old picture, if I can't get to it, but he's out on he coast; he's been working with an arranger -- a pianist, he's from Chicago; he's been working with Super Sax -- lives on the West Coast. (Lou Levy - ed.)
However, Ella was working with Shadow Wilson; Jimmy Wood on bass, a trio -- and John Lewis was playing piano. They were the four -- the Maldez Quartet. She'd work 30 minutes, we'd work 30 minutes.
Did Joe Joe have his show?
